definitions: A game in which two participants drive vehicles toward each other or a dangerous situation, with the first to swerve or back down being the 'chicken' or loser.
A situation where two parties engage in a risky confrontation, each hoping the other will yield first.
examples: They were playing chicken on the highway, swerving at the last second.
The two companies are playing chicken with their pricing strategies.
It felt like we were playing chicken with the deadline, waiting to see who would crack first.
